gpu_kernel_api_correlation.method: same globalTid; CUDA API start inside NVTX range; matching (globalPid, correlationId) on GPU kernel; shortest enclosing NVTX range chosen
gpu_kernel_api_correlation.caveat: CUDA Graph replay or asynchronous launches may lack usable API correlation. Unmatched kernels are not assigned by timestamp overlap.

nvtx_stage_evidence.interpretation: NVTX labels are CPU ranges. API correlation can associate launched GPU kernels; these labels alone do not identify prefill/decode or draft/target.
